top_signals.title: Tankers Are Being Hit Daily. So Why Is Oil Falling?
top_signals.summary: Brent tumbled 5% to $91 this week, as recovering Gulf oil flows outweigh tanker attacks, Houthi threats and escalating geopolitical tensions. Friday, November 20, 2026  Oil prices are set to post a 5% weekly drop as sentiment is still swayed by ample Middle Eastern barrels flowing to Asian customers.
